planets.name: WASP-50 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Chaophraya with a 1.96-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: WASP-50 b was found in 2011 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Chaophraya. Its orbit and size follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019's fit, the archive's default.
